evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says 'this could take five to ten minutes of your time' but never frames the promise of a dependable quote or asks for confirmation before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Asked after extensive probing — rep asks 'do you have any concerns about the moving process' only after collecting logistics details, not before.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raises 'How many movers would it be?' and 'what's the travel fee tied into the hour per hour?' — rep answers but does not dig deeper with follow-up questions like 'tell me more about that concern.'
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Rep does not say 'So what I'm hearing is...' or confirm what concerns were heard.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives a typical range ('normally for a one bedroom apartment we finishes at three and a half hours') and personalizes to drive time ('the drive time in between the location could be between one hour to one and a half depending on the traffic'), arriving at '$770 to $960.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Travel fee ($105), hourly rate ($190 for two movers), minimum (2.5 hours), and increment (15 minutes) all disclosed. 'No hidden fees of any type' stated explicitly.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or similar validation question. Customer volunteers 'God damn. Yeah, that's a lot. Okay, I didn't expect that much' — objection surfaces but is not solicited or handled.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Not mentioned at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Not mentioned at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks only 'Anything else before I let you go?' — a throwaway close with no substance.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' or any variant. Call ends after customer says 'Never mind' in response to the price.

top_strength: Rep gathered all seven logistics details systematically (property type, floor, rooms, walking distance, special items, TV size, storage specs, parking distance) and disclosed pricing structure transparently with no hidden fees.
coaching_note: Section 1 must open with the quid pro quo framing and wait for a yes before probing; Section 2's 'concerns' question must come before logistics details, not after; and when the customer objects to price, dig in with follow-up questions rather than letting the call end — the explicit close and Two Promises were never reached.
